title: Portainer Stack Redeploy Churn
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=portainer:stack action=deploy
bin _time span=1d
stats count as deploys by stack_name _time
where deploys>3
description: Detects Portainer stacks redeployed excessively in one day.
value: Surfacing portainer stack redeploy churn helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant home lab & self-hosting export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It shows when portainer stack redeploy churn matters for your routine.
